label: Bible Study
prompt: The last _____ that shall be destroyed is death.
verse: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
note: Death is on the list too — the last enemy, scheduled for destruction.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will _____ thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
verse: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
note: At Beer-sheba God appears to Isaac by night with his father's promise: fear not, I am with thee, and I will bless thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no _____, no bread, no money in their purse:
verse: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
note: A scrip was a traveller's bag — Jesus sent the twelve out with a staff and not much else.

label: Deep Water
prompt: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live _____ with all men.
verse: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
note: Paul's realistic peace clause: 'if it be possible' — you can only control your half of the relationship.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which _____ God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verse: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth God and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
note: In Jotham's fable the vine refuses to be king of the trees: why leave my wine, 'which cheereth God and man'?
